name: @paged-media/plugin-api
description: The Paged extension contract's source: manifest, bundle lifecycle, the BundleHost surface, and the contribution and engine wire types. Type-only and private: it is published as the ./api entry of @paged-media/plugin-sdk (PM-0008, amendment 3).
